Design authority: docs/delivery/workspace-design.md, sections 10.2; extended workspace. Visual references: mockups/workspace-vision-2026-09-22/README.md.
Repository owner: storyatlas4s. Delivery boundary: post-M1 / extended capability.
Integration parent: bd-01M1C2TVQTHW3KSESS9M0ET168; parent relationship does not itself block execution.
Entry dependencies: bd-01M35A7D5DH1AB8XYWH00DFFHE, bd-01M35A7BD356ZAYJ5JQ1G7TTTT.

REUSE, SCOPE AND PRESERVATION
Own participant/result switch and bounded small-multiple comparison in the same shell. Reuse checked joins, source target identities/cut, shared controller and existing matrix. This extension is outside M1 and the four-screen completion gate.

ACCEPTANCE AND FAILURE WITNESSES
1. Switch between independently identified recall inventories without aliasing local IDs or inheriting another participant selection; common source focus remains meaningful.
2. Small multiples hold source axis/cut and compatible measure semantics fixed; differing segmentation and clocks are explicit.
3. No population statistic or dense cohort tensor is manufactured; group summaries require provider estimands/denominators and missingness. Measure supported comparison scale.

EVIDENCE
Record exact producer/consumer/dependency revisions, fixture digests, actual commands/results and warnings/skips. Apply design section 11.5 and AGENTS.md to the changed runtime boundary, including compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll app/fastLinkJS and relevant existing/new browser courts for shell changes; use isolated siblings and session-owned project browsers. Documentation-only or human-study evidence is scoped as such. New test names are specifications until implemented and run. No inference, calibration, hosted CI, publication or release is certified by ticket creation.

FALLBACK
Keep single-recall switching and avoid unsupported aggregate claims; broad population certification remains in its parent.

Coordinate one implementation writer and one heavy build at a time. Reserve exact paths when taking the ticket; do not claim other writers' scopes. Keep scientific operations in StoryModel, reuse this application and preserve unrelated edits.
set.title: [Compare] Switch and compare compatible recalls on a fixed source axis
